claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament takes place April 6–12 at Augusta National.
2026 Masters Tournament Rounds 1 and 2 are on April 9–10.
2026 Masters Tournament final rounds are on April 11–12.
Round 2 tee times on Friday start at 7:40 a.m. ET for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Round 1 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Thursday, April 9.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 coverage is 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 1 coverage is 1-3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.
Round 2 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Friday, April 10.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 coverage is 3-7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 2 coverage is 1-3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 coverage is 2-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 3 coverage is 12-2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 4 coverage is 12-7 p.m. ET on CBS.
2026 Masters Tournament Round 4 coverage is 12-2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
